rationale: The agent verified identity properly using name + zip and matched to a single user before proceeding. They inspected the user profile, orders, and product details with read-only tools, then clearly stated the proposed changes and obtained explicit confirmation for both the order item swap and the address update. They executed the item modification via the tool on the correct order and reflected the new variant; they also updated the user’s saved address. The final message accurately reported the successful change and a refund to the selected payment method used in the tool call. A minor gap is that the agent didn’t offer to update the shipping address on existing orders (the orders still showed 443 Maple Drive), but the user did not explicitly request that after being asked; thus the core requests were completed in line with policy. No unsupported claims or actions on the wrong account occurred, and no writes were performed without confirmation.
